title: Universal homeomorphisms are integral
statement: For a scheme morphism r whose every base change is a homeomorphism [def-weil-universal-homeomorphism], r is integral, universally injective and surjective, hence satisfies IsUniversalHomeomorphism.

source.place: Tag 04DF, with limits.tex Tag 05YU and Tag 01WM

proof.text: Every base change is closed and injective, and r itself is surjective. Transport the affine opens of X along its homeomorphism onto Y. The inverse images are the original affine opens; use affineness descent for the restricted surjective universally closed maps to see their targets are affine. These matching affine covers show r is affine, and an affine universally closed morphism is integral.
